title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14923v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We address the second limitation and take a first step towards the first by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. translated_title: TLA-Verus：使用LLM智能体生成和求解时序证明义务
translated_abstract: TLA+（动作时序逻辑）形式化规范工具包已被广泛应用于对现代分布式软件系统进行建模，包括数据库、存储系统、账本和协调协议。尽管它在软件验证方面存在两个重大局限，但仍然备受欢迎：首先，TLA+无法检测软件实现与数学规范之间的偏差；其次，TLC和TLAPS无法为任意时序逻辑属性提供令人满意的证明。我们通过确定性转译器（transpiler）和智能体翻译器（agentic translator）将TLA+规范翻译为Verus（一种为Rust构建的自动主动式验证器），从而解决了第二个局限，并为解决第一个局限迈出了第一步。我们证明，基于LLM的流水线能够大规模地从TLA+规范生成证明义务，并产生完全可机器检查的安全性与活性属性证明。
tldr: 该论文提出TLA-Verus框架，通过确定性转译器和LLM智能体将TLA+规范翻译为Rust验证器Verus，能够大规模生成证明义务并产出完全可机器检查的安全性与活性证明，弥补了TLA+在时序属性验证上的不足。
